_about: The release status ladder (docs/STAGING_DEPLOYMENT.md section 5). A rung is 'passed' only with dated evidence a person can open. 'not_done' is the honest default. The application serves this at GET /admin/release-gates and never computes it: a test double can never turn a live rung green.

gates.label: Unit tested
gates.evidence: backend pytest on a fresh PostgreSQL 16 with migrations from scratch; see docs/PHASE_2_COMPLETION_REPORT.md for the run

gates.label: Integration tested with test doubles
gates.evidence: Google, Places, Razorpay and the AI are test doubles in these tests; browser suites e2e/autonomy-control-centre.js and e2e/agent-and-posts.js against an isolated stack with seeded data

gates.label: Tested against the real Google Business Profile API (read and write, read back)
gates.blocked_by: an authorised test Business Profile (docs/LIVE_VALIDATION_RUNBOOK.md stages 1 to 4)

gates.label: Tested against the real Google Places API (scan, measured cost)
gates.blocked_by: a Places API key and a test business (runbook stage 5)

gates.label: Validated in staging (current code, migrations upgraded from production-shaped data)
gates.blocked_by: a staging environment on the current code (docs/STAGING_DEPLOYMENT.md)

gates.label: Approved for production
gates.blocked_by: all rungs above, the owner decisions, legal review, and a rehearsed rollback (docs/PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT.md section 2)
